audience: service businesses that take appointments and bookings in Calendesk

useCases.title: See the bookings for a day
useCases.text: List bookings for a date range, filtered by employee or service. Open one booking to read its time, customer and payment.

useCases.title: Find open times for a service
useCases.text: Find the service id in the service list. Then list the available times for a number of days from a start date.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their bookings
useCases.text: Search customers by name, email or sign-up date. Then list the bookings of that customer.

useCases.title: Book a service for a customer
useCases.text: Pick the service and the employee, then create a booking on a date. Customers and staff get a notification unless you skip notifications.

useCases.title: Cancel or move a booking
useCases.text: Read the booking first. Then set its status to cancelled, or change its time. Calendesk has no undo.
